summary: Authored a 6-phase implementation plan. check-task-references.sh's hard-coded TREE_ROOTS is replaced by one repo-wide git ls-files walk filtered through the existing shared is_exempt_path (specs/** only), and the PATH_SCOPE-must-be-under-TREE_ROOTS exit-2 check is dropped; the shared pattern library and the write-time hook need no code changes. validate-wiring.sh gains per-arm existence guards emitting [SKIP] instead of cascading [FAIL] rows for an absent tree. Two new fixture-driven test suites cover a consumer-repo layout (including lint/hook scope agreement) and the .claude-present/.opencode-absent case. task-reference-exemptions.md's Enforcement narrative is rewritten off the four-root model. Option (a), coverage, chosen over option (b), carve-out, on the research report's measured 0/0 scan equivalence.

artifacts.summary: 6-phase plan for repo-wide scan roots in check-task-references.sh plus validate-wiring.sh missing-tree-root SKIP guards, with two new fixture-driven test suites.
